In the old source, seeing a [duck](content://f0438140-c7fb-5fc1-ba23-6daf02f8588f) in a dream is interpreted in connection with pride and idle gossip.

![](asset://019c2a10-4e61-7b48-9e26-8d51ca0743f9)

This old interpretation associates the duck symbol with pride and idle gossip. The main meaning of the source is preserved without adding any new interpretations.

## What does it mean to see a duck in a dream?

According to the old dream book, seeing a duck in a dream is associated with pride and idle talk. This is a traditional interpretation and should not be taken as a literal prediction.
